nodes.label: Rounded splash icon: glowing yellow bee-planet on a red-orange gradient
nodes.rationale: 1024×1024 RGBA PNG. Rounded-square splash icon: the four corners are transparent and the painted field is a diagonal gradient, deep red in the upper left (about #820D08) shifting to bright orange toward the lower right (about #FF4E17), with a soft glow behind the mark. Centered is a pale-yellow glyph, the bee-planet mark: two short detached curved antennae, a dome, a tilted elliptical ring, and a four-lobed body with a narrow vertical gap through the upper and lower lobes. No letters or wordmark.
